source_documents.title: 116年度軍公教員工待遇提升方案
reviewed_spans: Paragraph beginning 行政院考量近年我國經濟成長率... and describing the proposed NT$2,000 increases and 4% general adjustment.
Paragraph beginning 本案經人事總處... specifying the 2026-07-01 early effective date for the allowances via supplementary-budget procedures and the 2027 budget process for the general 4% adjustment.
Paragraph beginning 經專業加給... identifying 9.98%-5.88% examples as general-administration civil-service pay examples, not military pay.
source_documents.role: Executive Yuan proposal and its stated rationale; not proof of actual payment.

source_documents.title: 115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案
reviewed_spans: Paragraph beginning 行政院會今（3）日通過... states NT$607.6 billion in total expenditure across six policy areas and that the bill was sent to the Legislative Yuan for review.

Paragraph beginning 在提升待遇面向... states NT$10.7 billion was budgeted for the military/civil-service/education professional and supervisory allowance increases, each NT$2,000, retroactive from 2026-07-01.
source_documents.role: Executive Yuan bill proposal; the whole NT$607.6 billion is not the compensation amount, and the statement is not proof of implementation.

source_documents.title: 115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案評估報告
source_documents.published_at: not supplied in the captured source record; official listing says 2026-09
reviewed_spans: The listing states that the assessment report questions the statutory procedure and timing of submitting the supplementary budget before the statutory budget amount was promulgated.
The summary says the adjustment framework lacks a clear legal basis and objective quantitative criteria.
source_documents.role: Legislative budget analysis and criticism; these are attributed institutional assessments, not a judicial ruling or independent confirmation of payment.

fact_interpretation.status: proposal combines two allowance increases and a general adjustment; avoid portraying the cited percentage examples as military raises
2026-07-01 is the proposed retroactive effective date for the allowance portion, subject to supplementary-budget procedure; actual payment not verified
9.98%-5.88% examples refer to general-administration civil servants and must not be attributed to military personnel
NT$607.6 billion is the total supplementary expenditure proposal, not the treatment-adjustment allocation
NT$10.7 billion is the stated compensation/allowance allocation; the NT$2,000 figure is per specified allowance, not a universal base-pay increase
Legislative Yuan Budget Center's procedural/legal concern; not a final legal determination
Legislative report warns about short execution time and spending capacity; not a finding that the treatment measure was executed
Legislative report questions budget procedure; do not state its view as settled law

supplemental_currentness_checks.finding: The public record shows the supplementary-budget proposal as 排入院會 and lists proceedings dated 2026-10-02, 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-13; this does not show final passage.

The Executive Yuan asks agencies to seek passage of the 2026 supplementary budget by the end of November so subsequent administrative work can proceed. Treat this as evidence that the proposal was still in the legislative process when stated, not evidence of later passage or disbursement.
